97023.title: A display view is recorded on load and on each display or tab switch
97023.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser (private window) · Google Analytics DebugView access · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  • Your saved display is List.
  • There are enough work orders at this location for a Tech View group or Board View column to load more cards when scrolled.

Setup

  1. Click List in the display switcher once before you start, so your saved display is List.
  2. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in.
  3. Check the setup worked: Google Analytics > Admin > DebugView opens and shows your device within a few seconds of opening any ShopView page. If it does not, carry on but write "not checked by hand" for the event checks, as the Preconditions say.
97023.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and wait for the rows to load. In DebugView, count the work_orders_display_view events.
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  4. Click the Estimates tab, then the All tab.
  5. Scroll a long column or group so more cards load, then wait 30 seconds.
  6. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search, then click Status and tick "Approved".
  7. Narrow the browser window below 1024 px wide, then widen it back to full size.
  8. Count the work_orders_display_view events since step 1 and read the display and tab each one names.
97023.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: exactly 1 display view is recorded, for List on the tab you opened.
  • Steps 2 and 3: 1 more each, naming Tech View, then Board View (running total 3).
  • Step 4: 1 more for each tab switch, naming Estimates, then All (running total 5).
  • Steps 5 to 7: no new display view. Loading more rows, searching, filtering and narrowing then widening the window back to the same display and tab are not new views.
  • Step 8: total = 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 display views. The Work Orders page looked and worked as usual throughout.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display and columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R1, S12-R6, S5-R7, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 10 tests.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R1: “Measure display usage after successful initial loading and each display or filter-view switch.”
  • S12-R6: “Do not count ordinary row refreshes as new display views.”
  • S5-R7: “Measure display, field, and density usage as specified in Story 12.”
  • Tech plan Phase 10 tests refetch: “no event on refetch or continuation”
  • Story 12 prerequisites: “Reuse the application’s existing Google Analytics setup and analytics identity/consent policy. Work Orders view permission is required; field visibility follows S5-E2.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

97024.title: Fields on and off are recorded once per display per session
97024.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • You can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView, and your device shows there within a few seconds of opening any ShopView page. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • The event names to look for in DebugView are work_orders_display_view, work_orders_field_load, work_orders_density_load, work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change.
  • Your role has See financial data.
  • In Board View's Column Selection, VIN/Serial is on as a saved choice and every other optional field is at its default.
  • You start in a fresh browser session: every browser window was closed, a new private window opened and you signed in.
97024.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click Board View in the display switcher.
  2. In DebugView, count the work_orders_field_load events and read each one's field name, on or off value and source.
  3. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  4. In DebugView, count the new work_orders_field_load events.
  5. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  6. Click List in the display switcher.
  7. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  8. In DebugView, count the new work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load events since step 4.
97024.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: 13 events, one per optional Board View field (lead technician name, customer, asset, VIN/serial, progress, service advisor, clocked in, line count, line technicians, estimated hours, total price, on-site indicator, created date). Fields you never changed show source default, and VIN/Serial shows on with source saved.
  • Step 4: 17 events for Tech View's optional columns (the same columns as List, plus Assigned Techs), plus one work_orders_density_load event.
  • Step 8: no new field events and no new density events. Reopening a display in the same session records nothing again. The session's field-load events total 13 + 17 = 30.

QA lead decision, 19 Oct 2026: Tech View's count is 17, not 15. PRD version 64, S2-R4: “Tech View offers the same columns as List, plus the Assigned Techs column (Story 7), through its own column chooser (Story 5).” List offers 16 columns, plus Assigned Techs makes 17. The earlier 15 came from a developer's comment of 6 Oct 2026.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display and columns); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S12-R2 and S5-R11, read 15 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table). Field counts (Board View 13, Tech View 15) from Slavcho Mitrov's SV-10593 comment, 6 Oct 2026. In version 54 the clocked-in wording of S5-R11's field list changed (full name, answer 31); the list of fields is unchanged, so the expected results are unchanged. Product owner answers: Chris Ward, WO Board and Tech View question sheet (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gBGmNB4B1bRrD2ZJvBn1tuvbfxFPjcsKddz_I5H3CvU), answer 31, read 15 Oct 2026. Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

Step 2: PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 73 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R11, read 22 Oct 2026: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580).” QA lead, 22 Oct 2026: Board View records no density event in this release, so that sentence was removed from Step 2.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R2: “Measure selected and unselected fields available to each user, including untouched defaults and restored preferences. Record this snapshot once per display per session, the first time the user opens that display in the session, not on every open. Field changes are still recorded each time they are saved (S12-R3).”
  • S5-R11 optional fields: “*Optional fields:* lead technician name, customer, asset (year/make/model), VIN/serial, progress, service advisor, clocked in (the names of the technicians currently clocked in to the work order, shown the way List’s Clocked In column shows them today: the first technician’s full name, then +N, with every name on hover), line count, line technicians, estimated hours, total price, on-site indicator, and created date.”

97026.title: Default and saved settings show as separate groups in the reports
97026.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: about 20 minutes, on one day.
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; Admin sign-in for the setup (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button).
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • No Google Analytics access is needed: you read what the page sends in the browser's developer tools (Chrome or Edge). Press F12 > Network tab > tick Preserve log > type collect in the filter box. Click a collect request > Payload tab. Each event lists en (event name), ep.element_location (list, tech_view or board_view), ep.element_label (the field or density), ep.setting_value (on or off), ep.setting_source (default = never changed, saved = chosen earlier) and uid (the user). One request can hold several events, one per line.
  • Turn off any ad blocker for this site, and use a new private window for each user so their messages are not stopped or mixed up.

Setup

  1. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a brand-new user "ZZAUTOTEST Newbie" at this location with a role that has Work Orders View; finish the invite so they can sign in. Do not open Work Orders as this user before the steps. If the name was used before, use a new name and read the expected results with it.
  2. As Admin (the dispatcher): Work Orders > Board View > Density > pick Comfortable. Then sign out.
97026.custom_steps:
1. In a new private window open the browser tools as described in the Preconditions (F12 > Network > Preserve log > filter collect).
  2. Sign in as ZZAUTOTEST Newbie, open Work Orders and click Board View. Wait 10 seconds.
  3. Click each collect request and find the work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load events. For each write down ep.element_label, ep.setting_source and uid.
  4. Sign out and close the window. In a new private window open the browser tools the same way, sign in as Admin (your dispatcher), open Work Orders and click Board View. Wait 10 seconds.
  5. Find the work_orders_density_load event and write down ep.element_label, ep.setting_source and uid.
  6. Put your notes into two groups by ep.setting_source: default and saved. Write down which user (uid) falls in which group.
97026.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: ZZAUTOTEST Newbie's field and density events show ep.setting_source = default (they never changed them).
  • Step 5: the dispatcher's density event shows ep.element_label = comfortable and ep.setting_source = saved.
  • Step 6: default and saved come out as separate groups, with ZZAUTOTEST Newbie (their uid) under default and the dispatcher's density (the dispatcher's uid) under saved. Each user keeps the same uid on every event.
  • A fallback (a setting that could not be loaded) cannot be caused by hand. Write "fallback: not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • The report page itself is built by the report owner inside Google Analytics, outside ShopView, and is not part of this test (QA lead's decision below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R12, Story 12 report owner, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.
  • QA lead decision, 12 Oct 2026: these checks are judged on what the ShopView page sends to Google Analytics, worked out with the PRD's rules; the report page inside Google Analytics is outside ShopView and not part of this test.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R12: “Separate default, saved, and fallback preference cohorts in reports.”
  • Story 12 report owner: “Milos Vasic owns building and maintaining the reports in S12-R4 and S12-R10 to S12-R12. Engineering’s part of this story ends at sending the events; Story 12 is complete when both are done.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/12/2026.

97027.title: Analytics events carry no work order details, names or amounts
97027.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser (private window) · Google Analytics DebugView access · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Analytics access: you can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  • Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  • Technician (example): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" (kept as named: the expected results check that "Bravo Co" and the search text "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" never appear in an event), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co": Approved, with a lead technician and a total price.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create a work order with one line: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the number shown as [WO-1]. Pick any ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"); then pick Lead Technician "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha".
  4. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in.
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All > search "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" shows [WO-1], Approved, with a lead technician and a dollar amount in the Total price column (Column Selection > Total price). Google Analytics > Admin > DebugView shows your device. If the total is zero, the dollar-amount part of the check cannot be made: give the work order a priced line first.
97027.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu. In Search type "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo" and wait for the list to update. The address bar now ends with ?search=ZZAUTOTEST+Bravo.
  2. Change the search to "ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co" (add " Co" at the end) and wait for the list to update.
  3. Click Tech View, then Board View.
  4. Open Column Selection and turn VIN/Serial on. Then click Tech View and change the density.
  5. In DebugView, open every event from this session, not only the Work Orders ones (also page_view), and read every parameter, including page_location (the page address) and page_referrer (the address before it). Without DebugView: press F12, open the Network tab, type collect in its filter box, click each request and read en (the event name), dl (the page address) and dr (the address before it).
97027.custom_expected:
Expected results

The PRD rule this test checks, word for word (S12-R5): “Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values, but no displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.”

  • No event sent to Google Analytics in this session (including page_view), and none of its parameters (including the page address, page_location or dl, and the address before it, page_referrer or dr), contains the customer name (Bravo Co), a technician name, the work order number, the VIN, the search text (“ZZAUTOTEST Bravo” or “ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co”) or a dollar amount.
  • Anything that is none of these does not fail this test: the field keys and setting values the rule allows (for example board_view, total_price, on, compact, default), and the page address with no search in it (ending in /workorders).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 77 (26 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S12-R5, read 27 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Spacing (density) steps: PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 73 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 — S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580).” S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).” QA lead, 22 Oct 2026: the density step is done in Tech View.

QA lead, 27 Oct 2026: the expected results follow S12-R5 as written; a page address with no search in it is not a failure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R5: “Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values, but no displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.”

  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).

  • [User-B]: a brand-new user who has never opened Work Orders (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 First Use").
  • [User-C]: a user without see financial data (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 No Financial"), whose role has Work Orders View but not see financial data.

Setup

97029.custom_steps:
1. First use: sign in as the brand-new user [User-B], open Work Orders, click Board View. Read the events.

  3. View changes: click Tech View, then the Estimates tab. Read the events.
  4. Successful save: in Board View turn VIN/Serial on in Column Selection. Read the events.
  5. Financial visibility off: sign in as the user without see financial data [User-C] and click Board View. Read the events.
97029.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: display view with source default, and 13 field events with source default.
  • Step 2: the display view names your saved display with source saved, and fields and density show source saved.
  • Step 3: one display view per switch (2 events).

97033.title: Field selection rate is one combined share across all users, not an average
97033.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: about 30 minutes, over two different days of the same week (Monday to Sunday).
  • Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; Admin sign-in for the setup (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button).
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • No Google Analytics access is needed: you read what the page sends in the browser's developer tools (Chrome or Edge). Press F12 > Network tab > tick Preserve log > type collect in the filter box. Click a collect request > Payload tab. Each event lists en (event name), ep.element_location (list, tech_view or board_view), ep.element_label (the field or density), ep.setting_value (on or off), ep.setting_source (default = never changed, saved = chosen earlier) and uid (the user). One request can hold several events, one per line.
  • Turn off any ad blocker for this site, and use a new private window for each user so their messages are not stopped or mixed up.
  • Board View starts every new user with VIN/Serial off and Total price on.

Setup

  1. Settings > Roles & Permissions: create a role with Work Orders View but without See financial data (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST No Money").
  2. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: four new users at this location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Rate U1" to "U4"); finish each invite so they can sign in. U1, U2 and U3 get a role with Work Orders View and See financial data; U4 gets the role from step 1.
  3. Check: as U4, Board View > Column Selection does not offer Total price.
97033.custom_steps:
1. For each user below use a new private window with the browser tools open as described in the Preconditions (F12 > Network > Preserve log > filter collect). After each user, write down from the collect requests their uid, every work_orders_field_load event for vin and total_price (with ep.setting_value), and every work_orders_field_toggle event (ep.element_label and ep.setting_value). Then sign out and close the window.
  2. Day 1: sign in as U1, open Work Orders > Board View > Column Selection, and turn VIN/Serial on, off, then on again.
  3. Day 2 (a different calendar day): sign in as U2, open Board View and turn VIN/Serial on.
  4. Day 2: sign in as U3, open Board View and turn Total price off.
  5. Day 2: sign in as U4 and open Board View. Change nothing.
  6. Work out the week's figures from your notes, counting each user (uid) once. For each field: the users exposed to it are those with a work_orders_field_load event for it; the users selecting it are those whose last value for it (the load, then any toggles after it) is on. Rate = users selecting ÷ users exposed, over the whole week, not per day.
97033.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • VIN/Serial: 4 users saw it (U1 to U4) and 2 have it on (U1, U2), so the rate is 2 ÷ 4 = 50%. U1 counts once however many times they toggled.
  • The figure must not be the average of daily rates. Day 1 = 1 ÷ 1 = 100% and day 2 = 1 ÷ 3 = 33.3%, so their average of 66.7% would be wrong. The correct figure is 50%.
  • Total price: only U1, U2 and U3 could see it (U4 has no financial data, so U4 has no total_price field_load event). U1 and U2 have it on (default) and U3 turned it off, so the rate is 2 ÷ 3 = 66.7%, not 2 ÷ 4 = 50%.
  • Each user keeps the same uid on every event, on both days.
  • The report page itself is built by the report owner inside Google Analytics, outside ShopView, and is not part of this test (QA lead's decision below).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

97028.title: Blocked analytics never stops the page, settings or reassignment
97028.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser with a tracker blocker · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blocked Analytics Alpha Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co").
  • Work order Alpha Co: Approved, lead Ana; Ben is not the technician on its line.
  • Board View starting values: VIN/Serial off in Fields to display, Density not Compact.
  • None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".
  • Analytics blocked in your browser: a common tracker blocker extension (e.g. uBlock Origin) turned on for the QA site, or your browser's setting that blocks trackers.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blocked Analytics Alpha Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  3. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  4. Block analytics in your browser: install a common tracker blocker extension (e.g. uBlock Origin) and turn it on for the QA site, or use your browser's setting that blocks trackers.
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blocked Analytics" in Search — exactly 1 work order shows: Alpha Co, Approved, lead Ana. In Board View, VIN/Serial is off and Density is not Compact (change them back if not). The blocker shows it is on for the QA site. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.

1. Open Work Orders, search "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Blocked Analytics" and click Board View.
  2. Open Fields to display and turn VIN/Serial on, then pick Compact density.
  3. Drag the Alpha Co card from Ana's column into Ben's column.

  • Step 1: the page loads normally.
  • Step 2: the field and density changes apply at once.
